instruction.text: Listen and choose the correct answer below.

atoms.sound: My family and I moved to New York City a few years ago, hoping to live a good life here. I worked at a bank to provide for them. But now, everything has become much more difficult. The bank had to close, so I lost my job, and finding a new one has proved near impossible. My wife and children are trying to help out as much as they can, but none of us can find work. If this continues, we won't be able to pay our rent much longer. Our landlord will evict us and we will be homeless.

atoms.a: Which event or time period is the person living through?
Which hardships does the narrator face?

instruction.text: Listen and choose the correct answer below.

atoms.sound: Today at school, we learned to duck and cover under our desks, and what to do if there is an atomic bomb alert. We need to be prepared in case the Soviet Union attacks us. My older brother told me about the time our military used nuclear weapons in Japan. He said thousands of people died instantly. Everyone is scared that this might happen again now, and that we will be the victims this time. Our dad suggests we build a fallout shelter in the yard. With the threat of nuclear war constantly present, it is best to be prepared.

atoms.a: Which event or time period is the person living through?
Which measures are being taken to prepare for nuclear bombings?

instruction.text: Listen and choose the correct answer below.

atoms.sound: All my life, my tribe has lived in this land, but now we are being threatened by these settlers. They are ordering us to move to a designated Indian territory, but why, when we have lived here for centuries. Our chief is trying to negotiate with them, but I fear there is no point in it. We don't want to leave, but I have heard of what happens to those who resist. I don't want my family to be killed or enslaved, so we are going to comply for now.

atoms.a: Which event or time period is the person living through?
b: first arrival of Native Americans in North America

atoms.a: When was the Trail of Tears?
What does the narrator fear could happen to her tribe if they resist the settlers' orders?
